svg.title: Regional land-cover balances and retained point evidence
svg.desc: Panel A accounts for all 217 HUC12s using original cell-centre inclusion: gains enter a class group, losses leave it, and net equals 2025 minus 2023. Negative loss marks are a plotting convention. Panel B shows each watershed's gross forest-class loss and gain; the diagonal is equal gain and loss. Marker classes describe local retained point membership only: South Carolina 2026 draft assessment sites and gauges with retained flow observations. They do not describe the upstream area observed by a gauge, monitoring completeness, or causal relationships between classification changes and water quality. All 217 watersheds are included.
